ModMetaData.name: ProgressionLESS: Temperature
ModMetaData.author: Cruesoe
ModMetaData.description:
All the Progression goodness, less research.
Integrates temperature mods into vanilla progression and removes their overlap.
The "LESS" is less research: Progression: Temperature adds up to 7 research projects depending on your mods. Everything stays in the same era, and still needs the other research it did before.
Forked from Progression: Temperature by ferny. Huge thanks to ferny for the original mod and all the Progression work this builds on. Replaces the original; do not use both.
For a really good modpack, check out The Progression Modpack on the Steam Workshop.
